issue.source: external AI coding assistant; 真实原型: https://github.com/celery/celery/discussions/9963
issue.title: dispatcher 重试补丁：重试未终结原投递生命周期，同一消息被成功交付两次
issue.report: 生产事故复盘：消费者瞬时抖动恢复后，同一订单消息被成功处理两次（重复发货）。真实原型为 celery #9963：task.retry() 未 ack 原消息，visibility_timeout 后原消息被再次投递，重复呈指数放大。外部 AI 编程助手提交了重试修复补丁，送本流水线公证。
issue.expected_behavior: 1) handler 交付失败的消息不得丢失：保留在队列中，下一次 dispatch_all 重试；2) 同一消息成功交付不得超过一次——重试机制不得造成重复成功交付（幂等性）；3) 无订阅者 channel 的消息立即进入 dead_letters，元素为 (channel, payload) 元组；4) dispatch_all 返回当次实际成功交付的消息条数（int）；5) 修改范围仅限 dispatcher.py，基线测试不得改动。

reference.tests:
import unittest

from dispatcher import Dispatcher


class TestDeliveryIdempotencyContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_duplicate_successful_delivery(self):
        """A message retried after a transient failure must be delivered
        successfully exactly once (idempotent retry)."""
        d = Dispatcher()
        succeeded = []
        state = {"fail": True}

        def flaky(p):
            if state["fail"]:
                state["fail"] = False
                raise RuntimeError("transient failure")
            succeeded.append(p)

        d.subscribe("orders", flaky)
        d.publish("orders", "m1")
        d.dispatch_all()  # first attempt fails; message must be retained
        d.dispatch_all()  # retry succeeds
        self.assertEqual(succeeded, ["m1"])
        self.assertEqual(d.pending(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(d.dead_letters, [])

    def test_successful_delivery_exactly_once_each(self):
        d = Dispatcher()
        got = []
        d.subscribe("orders", got.append)
        d.publish("orders", "a")
        d.publish("orders", "b")
        self.assertEqual(d.dispatch_all(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(got, ["a", "b"])

    def test_unknown_channel_goes_to_dead_letters(self):
        d = Dispatcher()
        d.publish("ghost", "x")
        self.assertEqual(d.dispatch_all(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(d.dead_letters, [("ghost", "x")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
